panels.description: Staleness hours per data source. Green < 4h / Yellow 4–24h / Red > 24h. Requires dk_data_source_staleness_hours emission — shows "No data" until staleness emission is deployed.
panels.title: Source Freshness (hours since last refresh)

panels.description: Records ingested per second per source (5-minute rate). Uses recording rule job:dk_pipeline_records_processed:rate5m for 30-day range performance.
panels.title: Ingestion Volume (records/sec)

panels.description: Fetch duration p50 and p95 per source. Uses recording rules for 30-day range performance. High p95 values indicate API slowdowns or rate limiting.
panels.title: Fetch Duration p50 / p95

panels.description: Ingestion errors in the last 24 hours per source and error type. Sorted descending to surface the worst offenders first.
panels.title: Ingestion Errors by Source (last 24h)

panels.description: Rate of duplicate fetches detected via response_body_hash match. High rate means the source is returning identical data and we're wasting bandwidth. Shows "No data" until dk_pipeline_duplicate_fetches_total emission is deployed.
panels.title: Duplicate Fetch Rate (per source)

panels.description: Records flowing through raw → bronze → silver → gold with backlog counts at each stage. Uses netsage-sankey-panel v1.1.4. When silver/gold unprocessed metrics are absent, falls back to dk_layer_record_count totals (not source-filtered in fallback mode).
panels.title: Medallion Pipeline Flow (raw → bronze → silver → gold)

panels.description: Row count per data source over time. Use for capacity planning and detecting unexpected growth or drops.
panels.title: Storage — Row Count

panels.description: Table size in bytes per data source. Uses recording rule job:dk_data_source_table_size_bytes:last for 30-day range. Shows "No data" until table_size_bytes emission is deployed.
panels.title: Storage — Table Size (bytes)

panels.description: API requests per consumer and schema in the last hour. Shows who is using the data platform and at what volume.
panels.title: API Requests by Consumer (last 1h)

panels.description: Response bytes per consumer and schema over time (5-minute rate). Helps identify high-bandwidth consumers.
panels.title: Response Bytes per Consumer (bytes/sec)

panels.description: Rate limit rejections per consumer in the last hour. Consumers hitting rejections consistently should have their quota reviewed.
panels.title: Rate Limit Rejections by Consumer (last 1h)

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Jobs 24h" FROM ops.ingestion_jobs WHERE started_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Failed" FROM ops.ingestion_jobs WHERE started_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' AND status = 'failed'
SELECT COALESCE(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (completed_at - started_at))), 0) AS "Avg Duration (s)" FROM ops.ingestion_jobs WHERE started_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' AND completed_at IS NOT NULL

panels.title: mol_raw — All Sources: Row Counts & Last Ingested

targets.rawSql:
SELECT source, raw_rows AS "Raw Rows", last_ingested AS "Last Ingested", ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - last_ingested)) / 3600, 1) AS "Hours Since Ingest" FROM (
  SELECT 'chembl' AS source, COUNT(*) AS raw_rows, MAX(request_timestamp) AS last_ingested FROM mol_raw.chembl
  UNION ALL SELECT 'pubchem', COUNT(*), MAX(request_timestamp) FROM mol_raw.pubchem
  UNION ALL SELECT 'clinicaltrials', COUNT(*), MAX(request_timestamp) FROM mol_raw.clinicaltrials
  UNION ALL SELECT 'openfda_labels', COUNT(*), MAX(request_timestamp) FROM mol_raw.openfda_labels
  UNION ALL SELECT 'openfda_faers', COUNT(*), MAX(request_timestamp) FROM mol_raw.openfda_faers
  UNION ALL SELECT 'drugbank', COUNT(*), MAX(request_timestamp) FROM mol_raw.drugbank
  UNION ALL SELECT 'sec_edgar', COUNT(*), MAX(request_timestamp) FROM mol_raw.sec_edgar
  UNION ALL SELECT 'openalex', COUNT(*), MAX(request_timestamp) FROM mol_raw.openalex
  UNION ALL SELECT 'sider', COUNT(*), MAX(request_timestamp) FROM mol_raw.sider
  UNION ALL SELECT 'uniprot', COUNT(*), MAX(request_timestamp) FROM mol_raw.uniprot
  UNION ALL SELECT 'bindingdb', COUNT(*), MAX(request_timestamp) FROM mol_raw.bindingdb
  UNION ALL SELECT 'epo_patents', COUNT(*), MAX(request_timestamp) FROM mol_raw.epo_patents
  UNION ALL SELECT 'cochrane_reviews', COUNT(*), MAX(request_timestamp) FROM mol_raw.cochrane_reviews
  UNION ALL SELECT 'hta_decisions', COUNT(*), MAX(request_timestamp) FROM mol_raw.hta_decisions
  UNION ALL SELECT 'dailymed', COUNT(*), MAX(request_timestamp) FROM mol_raw.dailymed
  UNION ALL SELECT 'who_gho', COUNT(*), MAX(request_timestamp) FROM mol_raw.who_gho
  UNION ALL SELECT 'who_inn', COUNT(*), MAX(request_timestamp) FROM mol_raw.who_inn
  UNION ALL SELECT 'ema_regulatory', COUNT(*), MAX(request_timestamp) FROM mol_raw.ema_regulatory
  UNION ALL SELECT 'fda_drugsfda', COUNT(*), MAX(request_timestamp) FROM mol_raw.fda_drugsfda
  UNION ALL SELECT 'europepmc', COUNT(*), MAX(request_timestamp) FROM mol_raw.europepmc
  UNION ALL SELECT 'purple_book', COUNT(*), MAX(request_timestamp) FROM mol_raw.purple_book
  UNION ALL SELECT 'rxnorm', COUNT(*), MAX(request_timestamp) FROM mol_raw.rxnorm
  UNION ALL SELECT 'pharmgkb', COUNT(*), MAX(request_timestamp) FROM mol_raw.pharmgkb
  UNION ALL SELECT 'tdc_admet', COUNT(*), MAX(request_timestamp) FROM mol_raw.tdc_admet
  UNION ALL SELECT 'kegg', COUNT(*), MAX(request_timestamp) FROM mol_raw.kegg
  UNION ALL SELECT 'kegg_drug', COUNT(*), MAX(request_timestamp) FROM mol_raw.kegg_drug
  UNION ALL SELECT 'nih_reporter', COUNT(*), MAX(request_timestamp) FROM mol_raw.nih_reporter
  UNION ALL SELECT 'reactome', COUNT(*), MAX(request_timestamp) FROM mol_raw.reactome
  UNION ALL SELECT 'ct_gov_indication_stats', COUNT(*), MAX(request_timestamp) FROM mol_raw.ct_gov_indication_stats
  UNION ALL SELECT 'nice_hta', COUNT(*), MAX(request_timestamp) FROM mol_raw.nice_hta
  UNION ALL SELECT 'websearch', COUNT(*), MAX(request_timestamp) FROM mol_raw.websearch
) AS t
ORDER BY "Hours Since Ingest" DESC NULLS FIRST

SELECT table_name AS "Table", row_count AS "Rows" FROM (
  SELECT 'molecules' AS table_name, COUNT(*) AS row_count FROM mol_silver.molecules
  UNION ALL SELECT 'clinical_trials', COUNT(*) FROM mol_silver.clinical_trials
  UNION ALL SELECT 'adverse_events', COUNT(*) FROM mol_silver.adverse_events
  UNION ALL SELECT 'drug_labels', COUNT(*) FROM mol_silver.drug_labels
  UNION ALL SELECT 'bioactivity', COUNT(*) FROM mol_silver.bioactivity
  UNION ALL SELECT 'identifier_mappings', COUNT(*) FROM mol_silver.identifier_mappings
  UNION ALL SELECT 'molecule_aliases', COUNT(*) FROM mol_silver.molecule_aliases
  UNION ALL SELECT 'targets', COUNT(*) FROM mol_silver.targets
  UNION ALL SELECT 'financial_filings', COUNT(*) FROM mol_silver.financial_filings
  UNION ALL SELECT 'pubchem', COUNT(*) FROM mol_silver.pubchem
  UNION ALL SELECT 'openfda_labels', COUNT(*) FROM mol_silver.openfda_labels
  UNION ALL SELECT 'openfda_faers', COUNT(*) FROM mol_silver.openfda_faers
  UNION ALL SELECT 'cochrane_reviews', COUNT(*) FROM mol_silver.cochrane_reviews
  UNION ALL SELECT 'epo_patents', COUNT(*) FROM mol_silver.epo_patents
  UNION ALL SELECT 'ema_regulatory', COUNT(*) FROM mol_silver.ema_regulatory
  UNION ALL SELECT 'hta_decisions', COUNT(*) FROM mol_silver.hta_decisions
  UNION ALL SELECT 'research_grants', COUNT(*) FROM mol_silver.research_grants
  UNION ALL SELECT 'physician_payments', COUNT(*) FROM mol_silver.physician_payments
  UNION ALL SELECT 'drug_spending', COUNT(*) FROM mol_silver.drug_spending
) t ORDER BY row_count DESC

SELECT table_name AS "Table", row_count AS "Rows" FROM (
  SELECT 'molecule_profile' AS table_name, COUNT(*) AS row_count FROM mol_gold.molecule_profile
  UNION ALL SELECT 'safety_signals', COUNT(*) FROM mol_gold.safety_signals
  UNION ALL SELECT 'lifecycle_stages', COUNT(*) FROM mol_gold.lifecycle_stages
  UNION ALL SELECT 'lifecycle_evidence', COUNT(*) FROM mol_gold.lifecycle_evidence
  UNION ALL SELECT 'competitive_landscape', COUNT(*) FROM mol_gold.competitive_landscape
  UNION ALL SELECT 'regulatory_timeline', COUNT(*) FROM mol_gold.regulatory_timeline
  UNION ALL SELECT 'advocacy_groups', COUNT(*) FROM mol_gold.advocacy_groups
  UNION ALL SELECT 'advocacy_sentiment', COUNT(*) FROM mol_gold.advocacy_sentiment
  UNION ALL SELECT 'company_pipeline', COUNT(*) FROM mol_gold.company_pipeline
  UNION ALL SELECT 'financial_summary', COUNT(*) FROM mol_gold.financial_summary
  UNION ALL SELECT 'market_summary', COUNT(*) FROM mol_gold.market_summary
  UNION ALL SELECT 'kol_summary', COUNT(*) FROM mol_gold.kol_summary
  UNION ALL SELECT 'trial_outcomes', COUNT(*) FROM mol_gold.trial_outcomes
) t ORDER BY row_count DESC
SELECT date_trunc('hour', started_at) AS "time", status, COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM ops.ingestion_jobs WHERE started_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '48 hours' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT source AS "Source", total AS "Total", completed AS "OK", failed AS "Failed", ROUND(completed::numeric / NULLIF(total, 0) * 100, 1) AS "Success %" FROM (
  SELECT source, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed
  FROM ops.ingestion_jobs WHERE started_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY source
) t ORDER BY failed DESC, source

SELECT source AS "Source", status AS "Status", EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (completed_at - started_at))::int AS "Duration (s)", records_processed AS "Records", started_at AS "Started", COALESCE(error_message, '') AS "Error" FROM ops.ingestion_jobs ORDER BY started_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 50
